subject: School Calendar Policy Update
overview: The subcommittee reviewed and approved a revised school calendar policy that establishes guidelines for observing holidays and blocking exams and events on significant cultural and religious dates. The updated policy recommendation was forwarded to the full School Committee.

items.title: School Year and Calendar Policy
items.summary: The subcommittee reviewed and voted to approve an updated school calendar policy establishing static and variable holiday observance lists with blocked dates for exams and major events, incorporating Autism Awareness Day and Down Syndrome Awareness Day before forwarding the recommendation to the School Committee.
